latestVersion.changelog:
ai-photo-editor 1.0.0

- Initial release of AI Photo Editor skill.
- Instantly transform, retouch, and enhance photos with simple prompts.
- Supports background removal, color grading, skin retouching, object erasure, and style changes.
- Automatic setup connects you to a cloud-based, GPU-accelerated editing backend.
- Handles file uploads, session management, and real-time results with easy-to-understand feedback.
- Includes error handling, credits management, and export functions for common formats.
